cards.title: Top of the Ladder
cards.instruction: Carry yourself as the highest-status person present. Treat questions as requests for your approval.

cards.title: Affectionate Resentment
cards.instruction: Remain warm and familiar while letting old resentment sharpen beneath every caring gesture.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'll decide how we handle this. Here's your tea, love. Exactly right, even without a birthday reminder.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I've brought cake. A month late, I know.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: You can question the details after my decision. Your favourite, too. I'll warm your plate; I've kept the candle ready.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Put it in. I'll sing now.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Come closer, love. I'll shield the flame. We don't want it stopping halfway through like last year's birthday call.

cardFidelity.evidence: A1 affectionate tea and A5 flame care carry resentment, but A3 blunt question deferral breaks sustained warm familiarity; highest status is pasted rather than blended with care.

responseLogic.evidence: B2 late cake prompts A3 warmed plate and ready candle; B4 song offer causes A5 flame protection tied to a prior interrupted call.

relationship.evidence: B2 acknowledges lateness and B4 offers immediate singing, showing an active repair attempt.

heightening.evidence: B4 singing makes A5 concern for uninterrupted flame recall the earlier birthday call failure.

specificity.evidence: A1 birthday reminder and B2 month late establish hurt; A5 last-year call adds a related precedent.

brevityWit.evidence: A5 shield flame/call stopping earns the barb from B4 song, but the A3 stock reprimand lacks affectionate cover.
